title: Cross-subject decoding of imagined speech from scalp EEG: a leakage-controlled evaluation on three public corpora
abstract: arXiv:2610.20954v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Objective. A decoder of imagined speech that works for a new user without calibration would make a non-invasive speech interface practical. We tested whether imagined-speech content recorded with scalp electroencephalography (EEG) transfers across people, and examined why accuracy within a single person remains low. Approach. We analyzed three public corpora, ds003626, KaraOne and Track 3 of the 2020 International Brain-Computer Interface Competition, under a protocol that enforces split integrity by assertion and reports exact binomial thresholds, group tests and bootstrap confidence intervals. We trained decoders on each participant and tested them on every other, compared representational geometry across participants without a classifier, applied subject-level alignment, and tested five explanations for the within-subject ceiling. translated_title: 基于头皮脑电的跨被试想象语音解码：在三个公开数据集上的防数据泄漏评估
translated_abstract: 目的：一个无需校准即可适用于新用户的想象语音解码器将使非侵入式语音接口走向实用。我们检验了头皮脑电图（EEG）记录的想象语音内容能否在人与人之间迁移，并探讨了单个被试内解码准确率仍然偏低的原因。方法：我们分析了三个公开数据集——ds003626、KaraOne 以及 2020 年国际脑机接口竞赛 Track 3——所采用的评估协议通过断言强制保证数据划分的完整性，并报告精确二项式阈值、组级检验和自助法置信区间。我们以每名参与者的数据训练解码器并在其余所有参与者上进行测试，在不使用分类器的情况下比较参与者之间的表征几何结构，应用被试级对齐方法，并针对被试内性能上限检验了五种可能的解释。主要结果：在 482 个有序的参与者配对中，没有任何一对在多重比较校正后仍保持显著（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究在三个公开脑电数据集上采用严格防数据泄漏的评估协议，发现头皮EEG想象语音解码无法跨被试迁移，并系统检验了被试内解码准确率受限的多种可能解释。
en_tdlr: Using a leakage-controlled evaluation across three public EEG corpora, this study shows that imagined-speech decoding from scalp EEG does not transfer between subjects and systematically tests explanations for the low within-subject decoding accuracy.
